definitions: To harm oneself out of anger or a desire for revenge, even if the self-inflicted harm is greater than the initial grievance.
To take an action intended to punish someone else, but which ends up causing more trouble or damage to oneself.
examples: Don't cut off your nose to spite your face by quitting your job just because you had a disagreement with your boss.
Refusing to compromise on the project budget would be cutting off your nose to spite your face, as it will only delay the entire initiative.
She decided to sell her shares at a loss, cutting off her nose to spite her face, just to avoid dealing with her former business partner.
lemma: cut off your nose to spite your face
synonyms: bite off more than one can chew
source: cut off your nose to spite your face
